shop.name: The Forever Can
shop.deliveryNote: About $11.24 delivery on the live Etsy listing
shop.materials: Clear acrylic cylindrical shell, interchangeable nickel or gold metal insert, cutting template
shop.care: Wipe the acrylic. Swap the paper. No glue, no peel.
shop.lookbookNote: Bring your leftover roll — or start with this look. Patterns are inspiration until custom SKUs exist. Checkout is the live Etsy listing.

howItWorks.title: Hang the wallpaper
howItWorks.body: Paper the room as usual. Keep the leftover scraps from the roll — that leftover paper is the whole product.

howItWorks.title: Trace the template
howItWorks.body: Lay the included cutting template on the leftover paper. Trace with a pen. One template, one wrap.

howItWorks.title: Cut, overlap, drop
howItWorks.body: Cut the paper. Overlap the ends. Drop the wrap behind the clear acrylic shell. The metal insert holds it.

howItWorks.title: Match the wall. Swap later.
howItWorks.body: The can now matches the room. When you redecorate — or want seasonal paper, photos, or art — swap the wrap. The can lasts forever.

patterns.name: Palm Aviary
patterns.title: Forever Can in Palm Aviary
patterns.story: The leftover roll from this wall wraps the can. Palm, peacock, parrot — one paper, two surfaces.
patterns.description: Forever Can in Palm Aviary. A tropical wallpaper look: palms, peacocks, and a nickel rim flush against the same paper on the wall. Bring your leftover roll — or start with this look.
patterns.longDescription: This is the product story in one photograph: leftover tropical wallpaper from the wall, traced with the template, dropped behind the clear acrylic. The can disappears into the room. Nickel or gold insert at Etsy checkout. $59.95 on WallpaperWastebasket listing 1552653332.

patterns.name: Blush Garden
patterns.title: Forever Can in Blush Garden

patterns.title: Forever Can in Sage Chinoiserie

patterns.name: Blush Damask

patterns.name: Fern Conservatory

patterns.title: Forever Can in Calacatta Stone
